items.title: Conservative climate policy blueprint under scrutiny after net-zero cost error emerges
items.summary: The Conservative Party’s shadow chancellor has announced plans to scrap a series of environmental and net-zero policies, including the Future Homes Standard and the Climate Change Act, as part of a wider programme of economic deregulation.

items.title: England suffers worst harvest on record after extreme summer weather
items.summary: New data from the Department for Environment, Food and Rural Affairs (Defra) has revealed that England suffered its worst cereals and oilseed harvest since 1984 this year.

items.title: TWO WEEKS TO GO: How AI can accelerate investment in climate solutions
items.summary: With just two weeks to go, sustainability professionals are invited to register for an upcoming edie webinar exploring how artificial intelligence (AI), market intelligence and human expertise can help businesses identify credible climate investment opportunities and secure the financial backing needed to turn sustainability ambitions into action.

items.title: Low-carbon transitional sectors prone to increased greenwashing risks, research finds
items.summary: The transition to a low-carbon economy is creating new greenwashing risks across a more diverse set of sectors, with links to misleading claims up 28% year on year.

items.title: MacArthur Foundation Expands Impact Investment Allocation to $750 Million
items.summary: The MacArthur Foundation is expanding its impact investment allocation to $750 million, increasing its dedicated capital pool by 50%.

items.title: SAS Appoints Isabelle Nordin as Head of Sustainability to Lead Climate Strategy
items.summary: Scandinavian Airlines (SAS) has appointed Isabelle Nordin as its new Head of Sustainability, placing an experienced internal leader at the centre of its climate strategy and regulatory agenda.

items.title: Trump’s New USDA Rules Restrict Farmers’ Access to $4.8B Energy Program
items.summary: President Donald Trump’s administration is tightening access to federal renewable energy funding for American farmers.

items.title: EY Launches Climate Resilience Center in Singapore to Drive ASEAN Investment
items.summary: Singapore has become the regional base for EY’s new Climate Resilience Center of Excellence (CoE), designed to help Southeast Asian businesses convert climate commitments into measurable financial and operational outcomes.

items.title: Amazon, Microsoft Fund German Wetland Project to Restore 750M Litres of Water
items.summary: Amazon and Microsoft are financing a major groundwater replenishment project in Hesse, Germany, targeting one of Frankfurt’s most important drinking water sources.

items.title: EFRAG Appoints Kristian Koktvedgaard as Acting Sustainability Reporting Chair
items.summary: The European Financial Reporting Advisory Group (EFRAG) has appointed Kristian Koktvedgaard as Acting Chair of its Sustainability Reporting Board (EFRAG SRB), effective immediately.
